title: Energy Guards; Vorticity Stretches
mathematical_role: Expose the geometric intuition of three-dimensional vortex stretching while keeping the global energy identity analytically separate.
learning_objective: See a vortex tube lengthen and thin along a stretching direction, relate it to (ω·∇)u, and distinguish that local mechanism from global energy dissipation.
literal_semantics: The composition contrasts a shorter thicker tube with a longer thinner tube along a labelled stretching direction.
The global kinetic-energy identity is displayed separately.
nonliteral_semantics: The fluid field and vortex tubes are literary perspective schematics, not computed fields.
Tube length, thickness, color, and stream lines are qualitative.
The stretching arrow is not a computed strain eigenvector.
No energy cascade or finite-time singularity is simulated.

accessibility.alt_text: Within a dark fluid field, a short thick vortex tube is contrasted with a longer thinner tube along a stretching direction; local vorticity dynamics and the global energy identity are shown separately.
accessibility.long_description: Stream-like background curves surround a short thick perspective tube and a longer thinner tube. A labelled stretching direction connects the geometry to the vorticity equation; a separate panel carries the energy guard.

supersession_reason: Gives the stretching mechanism legible three-dimensional visual drama while separating it from the global energy identity.
